answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 13 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 650 identities costs 650 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The spiral of the design is public, the meadow of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the copper of honest work is what finally pays.
